name: Stowl: Tab Manager with Cross-Device Sync
description: Save tabs to clean collections, close them, and restore anytime. Syncs across every device you use Chrome on.

send-all-tabs-in-window.description: Send all tabs in this window to Stowl

send-current-tab.description: Send only this tab to Stowl

send-all-tabs-except-current.description: Send all tabs except this one to Stowl

send-left-tabs.description: Send tabs to the left to Stowl

send-right-tabs.description: Send tabs to the right to Stowl

send-all-tabs-in-all-windows.description: Send all tabs in all windows to Stowl

send-current-tab-group.description: Send this tab group to Stowl
